title: Chapter 2
subtitle: You learned about BCG and Hepatitis B vaccines.

questions.question: What disease does the BCG vaccine target?
questions.explanation: The BCG vaccine helps protect babies from serious forms of tuberculosis (TB).

questions.question: What disease does the Hepatitis B vaccine target?.
questions.explanation: The Hepatitis B vaccine protects babies from hepatitis B, a disease that affects the liver.

questions.question: Why are vaccines given to newborns?

answers.text: To protect them from serious diseases

questions.explanation: Vaccines help protect newborns from serious diseases early in life.

questions.question: Which can be a symptom of tuberculosis (TB)?
questions.explanation: TB can cause a long-lasting cough, fever, weight loss, and tiredness.

questions.question: Which can be a symptom of hepatitis B?
questions.explanation: Hepatitis B can cause yellow skin or eyes, tiredness, and stomach pain.
